notes: Mrs. Lin's day at home with her daughter, inside the same senior-friendly bungalow as the Wongs' (seen-home-wong, stamped on the home-lin pad), for scripts/build-community-tracks.mjs (schema: docs/COMMUNITY.md, Cast files). Loop seconds (720 s = 8 AM-4 PM).

Positions are facility-local (plan frame P, +x east, +z north, metres); headings follow three.js (heading h faces (sin h, cos h)). `at` is a seat object (chairs and benches: seatPose) or a point with `heading`; `seat` names the furniture a seated point sits on.

Mrs. Lin is the story's participant (the center's hero-lin / arrival-cane): `profileId` arrival-cane gives her the same look. She wakes at 0.5 s (the loop seam out of sight: tea on the sofa at 4 PM, her bed at 8 AM), breakfasts with her daughter, puts her shoes and cardigan on at the entry bench and leaves by the front door at 23 s; her time outside (the Seen van there and back, her day at the center) is the away hole 23-659 that HOLE_LEGS fills in community-people.ts. Home at 659 s, tea on the sofa to the end of the day.

Her daughter (role family, neither staff nor participant) works from home. Front-door passes: out 21 and in 57 (seeing her mother onto the van and back by the porch step), out 614 and in 661 (watching for the van on the porch, meeting it at the ramp foot and up the ramp behind her mother). Door passes are at least 2 s apart.

lin-van-pickup (19-49) and lin-van-dropoff (630-661) are outdoors in community-people.ts, with the van driver (lin-van-driver). Ids kept stable: lin-at-home, lin-daughter, lin-breakfast, lin-evening (lin-evening covers 700-720: the story closes on it).
